patterns: APPSC asks basics directly: FRs are granted by the Constitution (not absolute/inalienable), number of FRs = six, FR-or-not items (employment, equal pay, property).
Citizens-only vs all-persons articles (15, 16, 19, 29, 30) recur across PSCs; APPSC G1 2022 asked rights denied to aliens.
Article 13 = constitutional supremacy over ordinary law / basis of judicial review; 'law' includes custom or usage (UPSC 2026).
Scenario-type 'which may violate FRs' (APPSC G1: not paying minimum wages - Art. 23) appears; 44th Amendment removed property.
App MCQs add doctrine-to-case matching (eclipse, severability, waiver) and Art. 12 instrumentality cases; no PYQ here tests those doctrines, but they are standard and sound.
